policy.stop: After functional, installation and representative performance acceptance.

knowledge_provenance: Fresh Graphify 0.9.100 extraction: 434 structural nodes, 768 relations, reviewed into 8 functional leaves. Source-free author receives semantic contracts and interfaces, never original function bodies or tests. No earlier candidate implementation or pass reused.
source_preparation: Four documentation symlinks were materialized into identical target contents for graph import. Production source, configuration and upstream tests are unchanged.
installation_environment: Fresh venv installs candidate wheel built from sdist; pre-staged third-party dependencies reused. Target module origins audited. Not blank-machine internet dependency resolution.
coverage_limits: Linux aarch64 / Python 3.11 only; other interpreters and native Windows not executed
Observed contract coverage is not a proof of complete semantic equivalence
Agent-designed task assessment disabled; no claims about task-token savings

selected_candidate.reason: Select the latest successfully integrated full-scope draft, preserving prior diagnostic and annotation repairs and the restored packaging README. Earlier passes on the unchanged original are not candidate evidence; collect current verification before delivery.

artifacts.reason: Preserve the existing full-scope independent rewrite with owner-clarified annotations and diagnostics and cleaned generated packaging artifacts. This is an integration attempt, not acceptance; select the returned candidate explicitly and collect full current evidence afterward.

Preserve the independent full-scope implementation and prior interface/diagnostic fixes, with the owner-required authored README restored and source-only report mappings. Observe the returned candidate ID before explicit selection and current full behavior, installation, and performance verification.

limitations: Passing checks is not proof of semantic equivalence.
Criteria do not prescribe a next action.

annotation_audit.source: original public callable type declarations only
annotation_audit.limits: Only same-path, same-qualified-name callables are matched. Review inherited/relocated declarations and equivalent parameter spellings before treating a row as a defect.

elapsed_definition: Native job accepted through delivery acceptance, includes CPU queue, baseline capture, author/controller calls, checks and native report generation. Excludes host-side discovery/preparation and final Chinese report/publication.
usage_definition: Native controller/author model usage only. Input includes cached input; cache is not added again. Host conversation, Graphify static extraction and website-writing tokens are not included. These are not task-effort measurements.
